items.title: Flint forum puts AI data center growth under local microscope
items.dek: Residents in Flint heard directly from organizers about the power, noise and tax impacts of new AI data centers. The session comes as Michigan utilities prepare for sharp demand growth from similar projects. Attendees left with clearer stakes on whether such facilities fit Genesee County’s future.
items.source_title: AI Data Center Education ™ holds Flint community forum on artificial intelligence and data centers - theflintcouriernews.com
items.judge_note: New community forum in Flint with concrete event details; different city and meeting from existing Ionia coverage.

items.title: Saline mayor hopefuls split on Oracle tax deal and campus size
items.dek: Candidates differ sharply on whether to grant Oracle a 12-year tax break for its proposed $43 billion data center complex. One side argues the project will overwhelm roads and wells; the other says the jobs and revenue are too big to lose. Saline voters will decide which vision prevails in November.
items.source_title: Saline Mayoral Candidates Offer Competing Visions - The Sun Times News
